status: review-only V5 complementary keel and metal-indexed rear-bezel candidate; not a production print or shared-interface release

keel.construction: two source-aligned exterior facets with clearance and scuppers built into the boundary before solidification

rear_bezel.construction: legacy cassette exterior source facets rebuilt as a new open surface, with the shell seam inset and V0.3 metal aperture expanded before solidification

acceptance_holds: The V5 keel and rear bezel must be newly constructed complementary boundary meshes; subtracting complete legacy shell solids is prohibited.
All four body shells, the new keel, and the new rear bezel must each remain one closed manifold component.
The seated keel must clear both lower shells and the rear bezel by at least the configured geometric ownership gap.
The rear bezel must clear all four body shells plus the frozen V0.3 backplate, rails, shoe envelopes, shoe-tool envelopes, and adapter hardware.
The keel must remove first from below; only then may the rear bezel remove rearward.
All eight retained M3 datum/slot fasteners must remain accessible from below and may not carry the primary bike-mount load.
Both forward drains must be open boundary scuppers with positive analytic opening area; no barely piercing drain Boolean is allowed.
The two cylindrical wire ribs and 20 mm split rear wire exit remain required.
This gate does not release the rail sockets, revised front/top portals, ears, eyes, glow-panel mounts, or final shell seams.
A support/brim-inclusive Prusa MK4 ASA slice remains required before physical coupon or full-shell printing.
